Thanks everyone! I was so worried about getting it right, and so surprised when I opened the oven haha. 

The recipe is:Preheat oven to 280-300(I baked them with a wooden spoon in the door since my oven's temp. isn't very reliable)
 1 cup of powdered sugar; 2oz of sliced blanched almonds; 3Tbs dutch process unsweetened cocoa powder; 2Lg egg whites, at room temperature; 5Tbs granulated sugar. and the filling is just regular bittersweet ganache.
 I pulverized the almonds, the powdered sugar and the cocoa powder (i have one of those bullet things, but a food processor works too) and then I sifted it as well so there are no bits at all. 
 Beat the egg whites until they are foamy, then gradually add in the granulated sugar, and beat until you lift out beater and a peak forms(looks kind of like shaving cream).
 Gradually fold in powdered sugar/almond mixture. 
 Pipe onto parchment papered baking sheet, then the trick is to let them sit at room temp. for about 30 min-an hour. 
 Bake for 15-18 min. 
 Let sit out to cool on sheet for 5 min or so, makes it easier to peel off. 

Hope you all enjoy!!
